Gurugram Civic Office Receives Bomb Threat, Sanitation Workers Protest

Gurugram's Municipal Corporation office received a bomb threat via email, causing alarm and prompting an investigation by police and agencies. Separately, sanitation workers protested at the Municipal Corporation office by dumping garbage, leading to the police detaining 34 sanitation workers and taking them away in a bus.
